title: Next simulation phase
statement: For a machine $N$, simulation information $I$, and Boolean values $b,f,r$, define the next label to be the simulation test label carrying $I,f,r$ and the initial simulation state when $b$ is true; when $b$ is false, define it to be the phase label carrying $I$, flags $\mathrm{true},r$, and starting phase.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean nondeterministic Turing machine N
